list.name: [LPC] Larkspur Pet Clinic | Website Full Build

items.name: Week 1 · Project Setup
items.markdown_description:
Groups the day-one setup: the kickoff run, the ClickUp plan, the Claude Project, the gap questions and the welcome email.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 1 · Kickoff Call
items.markdown_description:
Groups the intake answers, platform access, the Kickoff Call brief, the call and the transcript.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 1 · Site Structure and Content
items.markdown_description:
Groups the Client Reference Kit, topic research and the sitemap, the homepage content brief, the homepage content and the editorial review.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 1 · Website Design
items.markdown_description:
Groups the Website Design task (open from Week 1 to the end of Week 3) and the Homepage Design for the Week 1 email.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 1 · Client Review
items.markdown_description:
Groups the Week 1 email, the client's feedback and the Week 1 handoff check.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 2 · Growth Blueprint
items.markdown_description:
Groups the competitor analysis, the Growth Blueprint and AM briefing, the Blueprint deck and the AM briefing review.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 2 · Sitemap Page Content
items.markdown_description:
Groups the briefs and the content for the remaining sitemap pages.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 2 · Client Review
items.markdown_description:
Groups the Week 2 email, the client's reply and the Week 2 handoff check.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 3 · Dev Handoff
items.markdown_description:
Groups rewriting pages the client asked to change and the dev handoff index.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 5 · Internal QA
items.markdown_description:
Groups the staging QA run with its BugHerd tasks, working those tasks and the AM review of staging.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 5 · Client Staging Review
items.markdown_description:
Groups sending staging to the client, processing their edits and the final sweep.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Week 6 · Website Launch
items.markdown_description:
Groups the go-live email, the launch and launch check, the leads dashboard, the SEO/GEO roadmap and goal tracking.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Post Launch · Project Close-out
items.markdown_description:
Groups closing out the project, the transition email and the move to the monthly retainer.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Post Launch · Case Study
items.markdown_description:
Groups the case study narrative, the showcase assets and the WISE showcase.

Done when every subtask is closed.

items.name: Run the New Build Kickoff
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 1 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** new-build-kickoff

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Run the new build kickoff for Larkspur Pet Clinic. Here are the signed SOW and the Sales discovery notes.

**Done when:** Claude has written the kickoff files and the gap questions.

items.name: Create the ClickUp plan
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 1b (Week 1)
**Who:** Project Manager
**Claude skill:** clickup-build-setup

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Set up the ClickUp plan for Larkspur Pet Clinic. Code [LPC]. Kickoff date 2026-11-16.

**Done when:** This list exists with every task, and Claude's answer ends with RESULT: PASS. Close this task once you have checked the list.

items.name: Set up the Claude Project
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 2 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** none, you do this yourself

**Done when:** The Claude Project is named, has its instructions pasted in, and has the kickoff files uploaded (see subtasks).

items.name: Review the gap questions
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 3 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** none, you do this yourself

**Done when:** Every gap question is either answered from what we already have or kept for the intake form.

items.name: Send the welcome email
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 4 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** welcome-email

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Write the welcome email for Larkspur Pet Clinic.

**Done when:** The welcome email, with the intake form link, has been sent to the client.

items.name: Process the intake form answers
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 5 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** client-context-update

**Message to type into Claude:**

> The intake form for Larkspur Pet Clinic is in. Update the client context.

**Done when:** The client context file is updated and any missing items are listed for the Kickoff Call.

items.name: Confirm platform access
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 6 (Week 1)
**Who:** Developer
**Claude skill:** client-context-update

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Check the platform access Larkspur Pet Clinic gave us against the access checklist.

**Done when:** Every invite on the access checklist is accepted, or the missing ones are on the Kickoff Call list.

items.name: Generate the Kickoff Call brief
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 7 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** kickoff-call-brief

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Write the Kickoff Call brief for Larkspur Pet Clinic.

**Done when:** The brief is saved and shared with everyone on the call.

items.name: Hold the Kickoff Call
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 8 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** none, you do this yourself

**Done when:** The call is done and the transcript is saved.

items.name: Process the Kickoff Call transcript
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 9 (Week 1)
**Who:** Account Manager
**Claude skill:** kickoff-call-processing, client-context-update

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Here is the Kickoff Call transcript for Larkspur Pet Clinic. Process it and update the client context.

**Done when:** The call summary is written and the client context is updated (see subtasks).

items.name: Build the Client Reference Kit
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 10 (Week 1)
**Who:** SEO Specialist
**Claude skill:** client-reference-kit

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Build the client reference kit for Larkspur Pet Clinic.

**Done when:** brand.md, voice.md, style.md and audience.md are saved in client-reference/.

items.name: Topic research and sitemap
items.markdown_description:

**Who:** SEO Specialist
**Claude skill:** keyword-research, site-structure-optimizer

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Run the keyword research and build the sitemap for Larkspur Pet Clinic.

**Done when:** The SEO has reviewed and approved the sitemap (no client approval needed) and the sitemap report is saved. Then type: Add the sitemap pages to ClickUp for Larkspur Pet Clinic.

items.name: Generate the homepage content brief
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 12 (Week 1)
**Who:** SEO Specialist

**Done when:** The homepage brief is saved.

items.name: Produce the homepage content
items.markdown_description:

**Who:** SEO Specialist
**Claude skill:** seo-content-writer

**Message to type into Claude:**

> Write the homepage for Larkspur Pet Clinic from its brief.

**Done when:** content/home/article.md and metadata.md are saved.

items.name: Human editorial review
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 14 (Week 1)
**Who:** Copy Editor
**Claude skill:** none, you do this yourself

**Done when:** The editor has reviewed and edited the homepage content.

items.name: Website Design
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** WD (Week 1)
**Who:** Designer
**Claude skill:** none, you do this yourself

**Done when:** The whole website design is finished and ready for the dev handoff (W3-4). This is one task for all of the design work from Week 1 to the end of Week 3. It waits only on the Kickoff Call, has no required inputs, and client feedback reaches Design through the AM.

items.name: Homepage Design
items.markdown_description:
**Plan ref:** 16 (Week 1)
**Who:** Designer
**Claude skill:** none, you do this yourself

**Done when:** At least one homepage design is ready for the Week 1 email. Design can provide more, but one is the minimum.
